tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Points of $W^+_\infty $ are neck centers] Any point $q\in W^+_\infty $ is the center of a $2\epsilon $-neck in $U_\infty $. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch The approximating necks have uniform regular curvature bounds, so smooth convergence produces a centered $2\epsilon $-neck at $q$.

□
